claims_checked.claim: Japan’s first Seven-Eleven opened in 1974 with roughly 7 a.m.–11 p.m. hours.
claims_checked.note: Widely documented chain history; 豊洲店 1974.

claims_checked.claim: 24-hour operation began in the mid-1970s and became a competitive urban norm.
claims_checked.note: Tiger-maru / Koriyama often cited as early 24h; treat as chain history not a visitor-facing statistic to memorize.

claims_checked.claim: About 1,400 Seven-Eleven Japan stores (~6%) had changed hours including overnight closures as of 2026 reporting.
claims_checked.note: Company statement via press (AdverTimes / J-CAST, July 2026). Figures move; do not freeze as eternal.

claims_checked.claim: 2019 franchise/labor conflict and FTC concern about forcing 24h hours.
claims_checked.note: Public reporting 2019–2020; legal nuance belongs to specialists.

caveats_about_absolutes: Note regional, generational, and situational variation
